name: Restaurant Brands Asia Ltd
title: Restaurant Brands Asia Ltd - 543248 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: India QSR SSSG hit 6.3% in Q4 with restaurant EBITDA 11.6% and GM exit 70%, but Indonesia impairment of INR120 crore and an unresolved promoter change weigh on the story.

triggers.label: Q4 SSSG 6.3%, highest in 12 quarters
triggers.quote: we ended the fourth quarter with a 6.3% SSSG growth, which is the highest that we have achieved in the last 12 quarters
triggers.highlight: highest that we have achieved in the last 12 quarters

triggers.label: Gross margin exit 70.2% in Q4
triggers.quote: we end the year at 70.2% in Q4

triggers.label: Impairment INR120 crore on Indonesia
triggers.quote: we did the valuation of the business on discounted cash flow basis

triggers.label: Cash from operations INR132 crore FY26
triggers.quote: we've only been growing cash from operations, INR99 crores to INR132 crores this year

guidance.quote: we should be able to kind of start getting to that number
which is within our guidance range of opening 60 to 80 restaurants every year

guidance.value: to be given in Q1 after deal close
guidance.quote: we will come to you with our revised outlook in Q1 once the deal is done

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have achieved our FY29 guidance of 70% this year itself as we end the year at 70.2% in Q4
This year, we've opened a net of 68 stores, which is within our guidance range of opening 60 to 80 restaurants every year

red_flags.label: Indonesia impairment INR120 crore and continued losses
red_flags.quote: we did the valuation of the business on discounted cash flow basis

red_flags.label: Cash balance fell to about INR190 crore; FCF negative
red_flags.quote: we still have cash on our balance sheet, around INR190 crores as we speak

red_flags.label: Popeyes losses IDR25 billion
red_flags.quote: We did lose more money than what we had lost earlier years, it stood at IDR25 billion

evasions.topic: Indonesia funding requirement and further impairment
evasions.quote: we will come back with you in terms of the detailed requirements as far as Indonesia is concerned

evasions.topic: Café ADS and product mix numbers
evasions.quote: We don't share product mix numbers for competitive reasons.
There's no -- none of that on any of the merger of -- they're very different businesses
